name: Gorgias
major_ideas: Sceptical extremes among the Sophists: Gorgias's nihilism
biography: A Sophist noted for the extreme sceptical thesis that nothing exists, that if anything exists it is unknowable, and that even if knowable it could not be communicated to others.
